title: OpenDana mod (mods/<id>/mod.json)
description: A mod is a directory that overlays the base package by relative path (last layer wins). mod.json has the same shape as pack.json except that a mod need not own any level: its lists name the files it actually ships, and the loader resolves any file present in the mod directory regardless of these lists. `content/base/pack.json` uses pack.schema.json. (additive, still schema_version 2): every file a mod declares must exist inside it (no '..', no absolute path) and be one the package reads; a `levels` entry that is not a package world file is a level patch (world-file shape; each entry's `number` replaces that package level only), and `graphics.chr_patches` writes the mod's own 8x8 tiles over the package CHR.

levels.description: Level files the mod ships, relative to the mod root. A package world path (levels/world-NN.json) replaces that whole world (all 10 levels); any other path is a level patch whose entries replace single package levels by `number`.

chr_patches.description: the mod's own tiles. The PNG holds whole 8x8 tiles row by row, written over the package CHR from `tile` on (all within tiles 0..8191); every pixel is grey 0/85/170/255 or fully transparent (keep the package pixel).
